response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) as avg_of_averages, AVG(track_count) as avg_of_counts FROM (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS FLOAT) / CAST(Milliseconds AS FLOAT)) as avg_bytes_per_ms, COUNT(*) as track_count FROM Track WHERE Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY MediaTypeId) as media_type_stats
